title: Red Hat Security Advisory: liblerc security update
description: A heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability (CWE-787) exists in the liblerc library used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10. This flaw can cause a denial of service (DoS) condition. The vulnerability is addressed by an update to liblerc version 4.3.0-1.el10_3. Red Hat has rated this issue as Important and released patches for multiple architectures. No CVSS score is provided, but the impact is denial of service.
